threads.body: [Testing] This changes the module's installed-agent default in the v3-preview/common-defaults-disabled configuration, but the module has no coverage for that enablement boundary. Add a `DefaultEnablementTest` that runs the same `@WithSpan` operation in the normal JVM and in a filtered task with both `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview=true` and `otel.instrumentation.common.default-enabled=false`, asserting the annotation span in the first run and exactly a manually created parent span in the second.

replies.body: not testing this is conventional in repo
